gallery.filename: Great Cobar mine - 'New Machinery, Copper Mine, Cobar' - c.1908.jpg
gallery.title: File:Great Cobar mine - 'New Machinery, Copper Mine, Cobar' - c.1908.jpg
gallery.source: Great Cobar mine - 'New Machinery, Copper Mine, Cobar' - c.1908
gallery.description: Great Cobar mine - 'New Machinery, Copper Mine, Cobar' - c.1908. This is a photographic image of a postcard showing construction at the Great Cobar mine (Cobar, NSW, Australia); left to right, new structure for the inclined tramways to the furnace charging floors, new water tanks and supporting structure, new furnaces building, new converters chimney (smaller one) and new furnaces chimney (overlapping), and new main shaft and its headframe. On the right are the headframes of the old Becker and Barton shafts, which continued in operation during the construction work.
